| Question | Answer |
|---|---|

| **Which sizes are available?** | XS – XL in true‑to‑size fit. |
| **Is the crest design printed or embroidered?** | The crest is digitally printed on the front to keep colours vibrant. |

| **Can I care for the tee at home?** | Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Avoid bleach and ironing the crest. |

| **Is there a return policy?** | 30‑day, no‑questions‑asked return for any reason. |
